topic.title_zh: 补上命令行、Git与开发工具
topic.question_zh: 会写程序却不熟悉开发环境，哪些练习能直接补齐工作能力？
topic.description_zh: Missing Semester讨论把工具空缺与实际工作联系起来；Learn Git Branching的正反体验提示互动练习仍要匹配已有知识。

resources.title: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education
resources.provider: MIT / Anish Athalye、Jon Gjengset、Jose Javier Gonzalez Ortiz
resources.format_detail_zh: 公开工具课程 / 练习
resources.summary_zh: 集中练习命令行、编辑器、版本控制等开发工具，补齐会写代码却不熟悉工作环境的空缺。适合刚进入Unix开发环境或已有零散工具经验的人。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 基本电脑与编码经验有帮助；已有熟练工具习惯的人可能觉得内容基础。
resources.why_recommended_zh: 读完材料并看完讲座的学习者报告在Git、Vim与命令行上更熟练；另一条评论清楚提示对经验较深者增益有限。

evidence.resource_title: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education
evidence.quote: I've read through all the material and watched all the lectures and I can say it has helped me tremendously thus far. I'm still trying to master all the tools they've mentioned but I already feel much more proficient with e.g. version control, vim, using the command line, etc.
evidence.reason_zh: 完整读看材料后的具体工具熟练度反馈。
evidence.author: wes1350

evidence.resource_title: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education
evidence.quote: To be honest, I was kind of disappointed with this, because most of it I already knew! (That's not a criticism of your course c:)
evidence.reason_zh: 已有经验者说明大部分内容自己已会，作为适用程度的保留。
evidence.author: fao_

resources.notes_zh: 首帖为2020年课程，后续年份有更新；不要将工具课当成完整计算机科学课程。

link_check.page_title: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education

resources.title: Learn Git Branching
resources.summary_zh: 用可视化提交图和闯关操作练习分支、合并与rebase。适合听过Git命令但难以建立分支模型的人。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 有少量Git使用经验会更容易；可作为专项练习，不能替代所有Git概念解释。
resources.why_recommended_zh: 推荐者认为它能暴露经验开发者的知识空缺；同一讨论也有偶尔使用Git的读者说rebase关卡仍然难懂。

evidence.quote: it's not perfect, and isn't going to completely de-mystify git. but it's a great exercise and seems to clear up a thing or two.
evidence.reason_zh: 保留推荐者对作用范围的明确限定。
evidence.author: guitarbill

evidence.quote: I tried this a while back, and I am so confused by the rebasing part I figured I'd find something else. As someone who knows some git, but only has to used it every once in a while, this website does not help me..
evidence.reason_zh: 实际尝试者说明rebase部分对低频使用者未必有效。
evidence.author: russdpale

resources.notes_zh: 收录的是一个具体互动教程，不是Git托管平台；推荐与失败体验同时保留。
